title: mcring AskResponse
description: JSON body of a successful POST /v1/ask (mirrors backend/app/schemas.py AskResponse; python/mcring_core/tests/test_schemas.py keeps the two in step). Voice-first: `speech_text` is exactly what the phone or ring should say; `speech` / `speech_adpcm` carry server-side TTS when it was requested or is the server default. `short` / `morse` are the optional silent-pattern output and are null unless the request set want_morse=true.

session_id.description: Conversation id; send it back as `session_id` so follow-ups see the previous turns and photo (last 8 turns, 30 min TTL).

answer.description: The spoken answer: 1-3 short sentences written to be read aloud (no lists, markdown, URLs or emoji).

speech_text.description: answer (+ follow_up): exactly what the phone (or the ring speaker) should say.

follow_up.description: Optional single short follow-up offer, e.g. 'Want to know if it is edible?'. Already appended to speech_text.

subject.description: Main subject identified, e.g. 'Digitalis purpurea (foxglove)'. Empty if none.

mode.description: Effective mode: `chat` whenever no photo was involved in the turn.

had_image.description: True when a photo (uploaded now or remembered by the session) was shown to the model.

transcript.description: Transcription of the uploaded voice question, if `audio` was sent.

transcript_error.description: Set when speech-to-text failed but the turn went ahead on the typed `question`.

speech.description: mp3 for the phone / headphones (`speech_format` mp3 or both).

speech_adpcm.description: 16 kHz mono mcring-ADPCM for the on-ring speaker (`speech_format` adpcm16k or both): whole 132-byte blocks, ready to split into AUDIO_DATA writes.

speech_error.description: Set when TTS was wanted but failed; the text answer is still valid and the phone should speak `speech_text` itself.

short.description: Silent-pattern text (== morse.text): <= max_short_chars, A-Z 0-9 space ? only. Null unless want_morse=true.

morse.description: Legacy / optional silent-pattern output. Null unless want_morse=true.

model.description: Model id that produced the answer (empty when the model refused).

fallback_model.description: Set when the configured model was unavailable and a fallback answered.

units.description: Alternating ON/OFF durations in units, starting with ON.
